plan.notes: Official ASU major map (Innovation in Society, BA, plan FIFISBA, campus ASU00); term-by-term sequence as published; retrieved 2026-10-06. One map row = one seed slot. 'X or Y' alternatives transcribed as one choice slot (choice=true). Rows with large option pools transcribed as one choice slot naming the requirement. Gen-ed placeholders (no course link on the map) transcribed verbatim as choice slots. Map 'Term hours subtotal' rows are metadata, not courses (wave-33 convention). The official map lists the following slot(s) in more than one term; transcribed as shown with allow_repeated_courses per the genuine-repeat rule: Complete 2 courses: Elective; ENG 101 OR ENG 102: First-Year Composition OR ENG 105: Advanced First-Year Composition OR ENG 107 OR ENG 108: First-Year Composition; Elective; FIS Upper Division Elective; Scientific Thinking in Natural Sciences (SCIT); Second Language: Requirement satisfied through the following: * Completion of secondary education at a school in which the language of instruction is not English; * Completion of a language course at the intermediate level (202 or equivalent), including American Sign Language IV; * Completion of upper division course(s) taught in a foreign language, taken in the United States or the relevant country.; Upper Division Related Area Elective.
